label: context.reference
text:
Use the Outlook Calendar Application through world_mcp_microsoft_outlook_calendar. Project EE policy must admit it, and the task needs its exact interface binding and this artifact binding. Installation and connection do not establish server liveness.

Use the server's catalogs for Outlook calendars, events, schedules, availability, and related capabilities that the connected server actually declares. Current capabilities are declared in mcp.operation_catalog, mcp.tool_catalog, mcp.resource_catalog, mcp.resource_templates and mcp.prompt_catalog from world_mcp_microsoft_outlook_calendar.

Invoke a tool with artifact.send to world_mcp_microsoft_outlook_calendar, label mcp.operation.request, operation microsoft_outlook_calendar.call_tool, and arguments containing the exact catalog tool name and argument object. Use microsoft_outlook_calendar.read_resource, microsoft_outlook_calendar.get_prompt and microsoft_outlook_calendar.complete with catalog identifiers; use microsoft_outlook_calendar.status or microsoft_outlook_calendar.ping to check liveness or negotiated capabilities.

Wait for the returned MCP result, resource, OAuth, event or refusal artifact before reporting an effect. Credentials, OAuth verifiers, tokens and refresh state stay private to the interface; transfer only non-secret handles and status artifacts.
